title.zh: 接合检验随同一编码保真
title.en: Joining questions remain exact under the same encoding

statement.en: Where a description lifts a joining, every branching test of the joining, its partners read through the description, holds at a fragment's code exactly where it holds at the fragment; under excluded middle a presentation reading these tests exactly and reducedly lifts a joining with listed outcomes.
statement.zh: 凡一个描述提升一个接合，接合的每个分支检验，其伙伴经该描述读出，在片段的编码处成立，恰当它在该片段处成立；在排中律之下，精确且约化地读出这些检验的呈现，提升结果已列出的接合。

laws.en: A joining relates two fragments to what they join into, in several ways, in one or in none. Read through a description, codes a and b join into c where fragments with those codes join into one with code c; the description lifts the joining where every joining of the codes of two fragments comes from a joining of the two fragments themselves into a fragment with that code.
laws.zh: 接合把两个片段关联到它们接合成者，可有多种、一种或没有。经描述读出，编码 a 与 b 接合成 c，是指有这些编码的片段接合成编码为 c 者；描述提升接合，是指两个片段编码的每个接合，都来自这两个片段本身接合成具有该编码的片段。

laws.en: With no premise, a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the joining's frame, the frame in which a fragment moves, with a partner joined on its left or on its right, to what the two join into.
laws.zh: 不加前提，描述提升接合，恰当“编码相同”是该接合框架的互模拟；在这个框架中，片段与在其左或右接合的伙伴一起，移到二者接合成者。

laws.en: Where a description lifts a joining, every branching test of the joining's frame (truth, negation, conjunction, and that joining a named partner on the left or on the right can lead to where a test holds; no atomic claims), its partners read through the description, holds at a fragment's code in the joining read through the description exactly where the test holds at the fragment.
laws.zh: 凡描述提升接合，接合框架的每个分支检验（真、否定、合取，以及在左或右接合一个指定伙伴可通向检验成立之处；没有原子主张），其伙伴经该描述读出，在经该描述读出的接合中于片段的编码处成立，恰当该检验在片段处成立。

laws.en: Under excluded middle as a named hypothesis, where each pair of fragments joins into listed fragments, a presentation whose codes read every branching test of the joining's frame exactly, and give one code to fragments passing the same branching tests, lifts the joining.
laws.zh: 以排中律为具名假设，凡每对片段接合成已列出的片段，编码精确读出接合框架每个分支检验、并给通过相同分支检验的片段同一编码的呈现，提升该接合。

hypotheses.en: One joining relation on fragments of any type, which may relate a pair to several outcomes, to one or to none.
hypotheses.zh: 任意类型片段上的一个接合关系，可把一对关联到多个、一个或没有结果。

hypotheses.en: The questions are the branching tests of the joining's frame: finite negation, conjunction and joining a partner on the left or on the right, with no independent atomic claims.
hypotheses.zh: 问题是接合框架的分支检验：有限的否定、合取与在左或右接合伙伴，没有独立的原子主张。

hypotheses.en: For the lifting from a presentation only: each pair joins into a listed finite set of fragments, excluded middle is a named hypothesis, and the presentation is exact (its codes read every test's answer) and reduced (fragments answering alike get one code).
hypotheses.zh: 只对由呈现得到的提升：每对接合成列出的有限片段集合，排中律为具名假设，呈现精确（编码读出每个检验的答案）且约化（答案相同的片段得同一编码）。

does_not_show.en: The laws fix the semantics of finite negation, conjunction and continuation; they show neither that an apparatus for these tests forms, nor actual negative evidence, nor access to every answer.
does_not_show.zh: 这些规律确定有限否定、合取与接续的语义；不表明这些检验的装置会形成，不表明实际的负面证据，也不表明每个答案都可取得。

next_delta.en: A warranted translation of residuals, guards and formation between descriptions with different internal syntax, telling the semantics of a test apart from the actual acquisition of its answer.
next_delta.zh: 在内部语法不同的描述之间给出余项、条件与形成的有据翻译，把检验的语义与其答案的实际取得分开。

correspondence.zh: 片段、接合及其检验解释同一活动内的关系；数学语义不等于所有问题已被实际取得。
correspondence.en: Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

detail.zh: 代表片段一致的输出提升接入复合结构。
detail.en: Representative-wise output lifting feeds the compound structure.

output.zh: 每个编码输出可由指定输入对实现。
output.en: Every code outcome is realizable by the specified input pair.

input.zh: questions_survive_encoding 在每个左右接续问题消费 operation_lifts，并递归保持逻辑联结。
input.en: questions_survive_encoding consumes operation_lifts at every left/right successor question and recursively preserves the logical constructors.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。描述提升结合处，每一分支检验经描述保留（Joining.holds_image_iff）；外围的分支问题即伙伴框架的分支检验，往返一一对应（ofQuestion、toQuestion）。外围的 questions_survive_encoding 在脊柱上成立（Joining.questions_survive_encoding_of_em），排中律作为具名假设 em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p，只用于在结果已列出时把通过相同分支检验认同为相同，即外围用经典推理之处；无此假设时，提升恰是同一编码为互模拟（Joining.operation_lifts_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Where a description lifts the joining, every branching test survives it (Joining.holds_image_iff); the periphery's branch questions are the partner frame's branching tests, read one to one (ofQuestion, toQuestion). The periphery's questions_survive_encoding holds on the spine (Joining.questions_survive_encoding_of_em): excluded middle is named as the hypothesis em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p and used only to identify passing the same branching tests with likeness where outcomes are listed, which is where the periphery reasoned classically; without it, lifting is exactly having one code being a bisimulation (Joining.operation_lifts_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
